title: Robust immune and stromal differences between PCD clusters
main_message: PCD_C1 shows consistently greater immune/stromal abundance across LUAD and LUSC

title: Robust Hallmark pathway differences across PCD clusters
main_message: PCD_C1 is enriched for inflammatory/immune programs, whereas PCD_C2 is enriched for proliferative/metabolic programs

title: Nonsynonymous mutation burden across PCD clusters
main_message: Mutation burden differs by PCD cluster in LUAD but not LUSC

title: KEAP1 mutation frequency across PCD clusters
main_message: KEAP1 mutation is enriched in PCD_C2 in both LUAD and LUSC

title: Copy-number alteration burden across PCD clusters
main_message: PCD_C2 exhibits greater CNV burden in both histologies

title: Cross-cohort methylation concordance
main_message: Most directionally concordant shared DMPs are hypomethylated in PCD_C2

title: TCGA-LUAD MPCDS development-cohort survival
main_message: Development-cohort median split shows poorer survival for High MPCDS; descriptive only

title: GSE68465 MPCDS external-validation survival
main_message: External GSE68465 median split shows weaker but significant descriptive survival separation

title: Continuous MPCDS prognostic associations
main_message: Higher continuous MPCDS is associated with poorer OS; external effects are non-proportional over time

title: MPCDS associations with PRISM drug-response AUC
main_message: No PRISM compound survives multiple-testing correction
